versions.changelog:
Initial release of generic-drug-scout V1.

- Enables one-click screening for China small molecule polymorph patent expiry opportunities, generating pre-filled interactive HTML reports.
- Outputs standalone, locally openable HTML files with built-in interactive UI—no server required.
- Exports only the report path after screening; does not display result tables or candidate lists in chat.
- Enforces fixed screening criteria: China + small molecule + polymorph, with expiry window as the main adjustable parameter.
- Provides fallback platform/server workflow and built-in sample data for UI preview as needed.
- Requires prior MCP platform configuration; guides users if not configured.
